teaching_language: This specific curriculum is fully English — study plan shows 10 INGLESE / 0 ITALIANO for this curriculum's own modules. The other curriculum of the same degree, "Economia e management dell'innovazione", is Italian-taught (8 ITALIANO / 1 INGLESE). Official presentation: "Il corso di laurea magistrale è articolato in due indirizzi, di cui uno interamente erogato in lingua inglese: ... il secondo International Business in lingua inglese."
places_available: Not published for this curriculum specifically.
academic_requirements: General Economia e management LM-77 admission requirements apply (Italian laurea triennale in an economics/business-related class or equivalent CFU distribution, assessed by the department); the International Business curriculum choice is made at enrolment. Full CFU breakdown not retrieved in this pass — recommend a dedicated check of the Regolamento didattico.
language_requirements: Admission requires only English B1 (same pattern as the other verified English-curriculum programmes at UNIPG, e.g. Civil Engineering-Structural Engineering, Accounting & Finance).
entry_exam_or_test: Not confirmed in this pass — no standardised written entrance test was found; likely curriculum/CV review as with other UNIPG open-access economics master's programmes. Needs dedicated verification, including whether a GPA threshold triggers an interview (as it does for the Quantitative Finance and Data Science for Economics master in the same department).
nulla_osta_required: Not confirmed in this pass — recommend checking UNIPG's online nulla-osta list.
application_deadline_eu: EU/legally-residing applicants: PICA pre-enrolment from 1 July 2026 (no published closing date); SOL enrolment for open-access master closes 1 March 2027.
application_deadline_non_eu: Non-EU visa applicants: this programme was not explicitly named in the confirmed PICA groupings (Civil Engineering+Geology; Medicine/Vet/Dental+...; Engineering Management). It most likely falls under the general window, PICA call 2026-visa-03, open 29 May-7 June 2026, 12:00 — CLOSED as of research date (2026-09-05) — but this is an inference, not a confirmed programme-specific citation.
tuition_range: EUR 150-2,200/year via a 17-band ISEE table. Non-EU/foreign-income students use a fixed Flat Tax by home-country UNDP Human Development bracket (Turkey = HIGH HD = EUR 800/year + EUR 16 stamp) or ISEEU Parificato via an affiliated CAF. Declaration window 3 Aug-20 Oct 2026 (late to 1 Mar 2027; missing 28 Feb defaults to the maximum band, ~EUR 2,096).
cimea_requirement: Not specified at programme level; see university-wide study-documents page for CIMEA/blackout-date rules.
double_degree: Not confirmed for this specific curriculum in this pass; UNIPG's general Economia e management internazionale (LM-77) master has a separate double-degree agreement with Université Paris-Est Créteil (UPEC), but it is unclear whether that applies to this M0206/International Business curriculum specifically or to a different LM-77 programme — needs verification.
